text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh, forty-seveeen... eiiight...! Niiine... f-fifty! All right!
In the gym, I spotted Bamboo Memory hard at work on her training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Right! That wraps up today's menu!
Let's see, towel, towel...
choice_data_list: Is this what you're looking for?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, <username>! Man, I worked up another great sweat toda—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, is that Oguri-senpai...!
Is she starting her workout right now?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...All right! Mind if I stick around just a bit and watch?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Hup!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! As expected of Oguri-senpai!
She benched 500kg like it was nothing!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well of course I am! Oguri-senpai is my ultimate goal!
Seeing her looking so strong just fires me right up!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...One, two.
Three... four.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, next up is barbell squats!
Starting with the Big 3 as usual—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—I'm totally fired up!
I can't just stand here and watch!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I haven't hit my limits yet either!
—Oguri-senpai, I'm not gonna lose to you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hup—hup—!
Shaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...
That's really starting to take a toll...!
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Hah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —When the person I'm aiming for is pushing herself, I can't be taking a break!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
*inhale*, *exhale*...!
All right! 3 more sets!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...!
Every muscle in my body is screaming...
I gave it... everything...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Good work. You must be thirsty.
Want some?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Thanks, I'll take you up on that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whew... But man, you still look like you've got plenty left in the tank, Senpai...
I've gotta train way, way harder...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
............
...I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...With that much grit and fighting spirit...
I'm sure you'll put on an incredible run when race day comes, Bamboo...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. We both have something to look forward to.
In the next race...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Ooooohhh~!
Same here, let's give it our all!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Until our showdown, I'm gonna train, train, and train some more...!
I'll make sure I'm in top condition when we meet!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In that case... how about we replenish our energy first?
The cafeteria happens to be serving a limited-time special right now.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sounds awesome! Let's definitely go for the mega-size portions!
Showing a glimpse of their burning passion for one another, the two left the gym refreshed—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Guh~! My motivation and fighting spirit are surging like crazy!
I'm gonna go run one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What? Isn't that pushing yourself a bit too far—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Here I goooo... Whoaaa~?!
It seemed she truly was at her limit; the second she hopped onto the treadmill... Bamboo Memory took a spectacular spill.
